Your holdings: SOXL is a major concern, down nearly 60% and amplified by its 3X leverage. SMCI is also deep in the red at -24.15% and near its stop. Remember, margin amplifies these drops significantly.

Watch: Keep a close eye on your leveraged ETFs (METU, MUU, SOXL, SPAL, PLTU, MSFU) as decay and volatility can erode capital quickly, especially with your current drawdowns.

Bottom line: Focus on managing risk in your deeply negative leveraged positions and respecting your stops.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting this 3X leveraged position given the severe -59.14% loss and decay risk.
SMCI: Watch the 37.3 stop closely; a break below could signal further downside.
QQQI: Respect the 52 stop; this income anchor is close to triggering.
